scenarios.description: Cold request reaches the existing ML container and persists the ranked result.
scenarios.expected_behavior: HTTP 200, ml_xgbranker, one provider call, one complete run.
scenarios.notes: Observed through the real public Laravel endpoint.

scenarios.description: Immediate repeated request uses the cache pointer.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Identical HTTP body with no provider call and no new persistence.
scenarios.notes: Cache driver was database in the isolated SQLite run.

scenarios.description: Cache is flushed and the same request resolves from database persistence.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Identical HTTP body with no provider call and no new run or item.
scenarios.notes: Persistence hit was observed after an explicit cache flush.

scenarios.description: A job-seeker profile field that participates in the context is changed.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Context hash changes and one new ML-backed run is persisted.
scenarios.notes: Content-addressed invalidation was observed through public HTTP.

scenarios.description: Eligible job ranking content is changed.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Old context is not reused and a fresh result is computed.
scenarios.notes: Covered by the Phase 17 Laravel end-to-end test.

scenarios.description: An eligible job becomes ineligible because the seeker has already applied.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Eligibility and context change; the applied job is absent from the response.
scenarios.notes: Covered in the actual orchestrator/resource flow.

scenarios.description: Five eligible jobs coexist with draft, expired, unapproved-company, and already-applied jobs.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Only the five eligible job identifiers enter ranking and the public response.
scenarios.notes: Eligibility was evaluated in the real recommendation flow.

scenarios.description: The primary ML container is stopped before a context-changing request.
scenarios.expected_behavior: HTTP remains 200 and MatchingService 2.0 fallback is persisted with a safe transport code.
scenarios.notes: No retry or public provider detail was observed.

scenarios.description: The current cache pointer is replaced with a structurally invalid pointer.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The corrupt pointer is ignored; the valid persistence run is used without new work.
scenarios.notes: Corruption was limited to the isolated Phase 17 cache.

scenarios.description: The latest persisted recommendation item is changed to an out-of-range score and cache is flushed.
scenarios.expected_behavior: The invalid stored result is rejected and exactly one complete result is recomputed.
scenarios.notes: Corruption was limited to the temporary Phase 17 SQLite database.

scenarios.description: Ten warm requests are issued concurrently by the client.
scenarios.expected_behavior: All responses are 200 and identical with no new recommendation run.
scenarios.notes: Ten responses; zero HTTP failures; zero partial runs.

scenarios.description: Five requests are issued against a cleared cold context.
scenarios.expected_behavior: All responses are 200 and identical; persistence contains no partial or duplicate-equivalent run.
scenarios.notes: Observed one equivalent run, zero duplicate-equivalent runs, and zero partial runs.

scenarios.description: Runtime tokens and unique fixture name, email, and phone markers are scanned across public responses, Laravel logs, ML logs, fault logs, and recommendation storage.
scenarios.expected_behavior: No secret or fixture PII is exposed; the fault server never records request bodies or headers.

scenarios.description: A bounded local timing sample is captured for cold, cache, persistence, fallback, and concurrent requests.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Measurements are observational and do not define an SLA.
scenarios.notes: Cold 473.487 ms; cache 305.423 ms; persistence 395.886 ms; fallback 1400.494 ms.

scenarios.description: The local harness owns temporary credentials, SQLite, processes, container, and ports, and cleans them in finally.
scenarios.expected_behavior: A successful run leaves no Phase 17 container, listener, or temporary root.
scenarios.notes: Primary Phase 16 image remains present; ports 8090, 8100, and 8110 are closed.

scenarios.description: Phase 17 feature, failure-matrix, and concurrency tests are executed independently.
scenarios.expected_behavior: All focused tests pass with deterministic assertions.
scenarios.notes: Focused results: 4 tests/2741 assertions, 18 tests/522 assertions, and 3 tests/54 assertions.

scenarios.description: The protected baseline artifact, baseline aggregate, frozen artifacts, Bundle files, and repository state are verified before and after Phase 17.
scenarios.expected_behavior: No protected file outside the approved documentation scope changes; frozen hashes remain exact.
scenarios.notes: Final verification values are recorded in the Phase 17 report.

limitations: Latency values are a single bounded local observation and are not an SLA or benchmark.
The PHP development server serializes application handling, so bounded client concurrency proves response and persistence safety but is not a production load test.
Provider protocol failures other than the real stopped/invalid-bundle container are produced by a loopback synthetic fault server.
No production database, production cache, deployment, queue, Redis, training, tuning, or Locked Test evaluation was used.
